semantic.justification: Original root-only fallback helper and distinct nested/horizontal-inheritance lookup. Retains source traversal of real/bogus parent entries, warning classification and visit counts, direct table-path attempt, extra root alias pass, mutable raw path cursor, helper bundle lifecycle, valid locale and alias target data, createPath segment reconstruction and source status overwrite order. Counted borrowed paths are distinct from strlen-based operations; no locale or resource-key heuristic substitutes for upstream control flow. The unchanged ICU78.3 uresbund.cpp public witness passes19888 queries: all982 direct package opens, all996 raw alias occurrences from root/keyTypeData, default/parent/root/direct and fill-in open modes, sticky failures, valid/actual identities, complete content digests, every initialized inline/path byte, long heap paths and the63-byte threshold, source alias-depth boundaries, scalar/iterator/copy state, same-handle/fill-in reuse and retained parent/pool references, plus756 actual ResourceDataValue data/valid-locale context cases. Source-valid narrow/count ranges and the pinned immutable default package are the certified projection; physical allocator/OOM/ABI/freed-pointer states and other packages remain uncertified.
